decisive_items: Echocardiography revealed pulmonary atresia with ventricular septal defect and a patent ductus arteriosus
Antiplatelet antibodies and platelet‐associated immunoglobulins were negative
Platelet aggregation time was 127 s (reference, 61–110 s)
response.rationale: The heart defect is confirmed by echocardiography, while the immune thrombocytopenia diagnosis is provisional and contradicted by negative antibody tests and prolonged platelet aggregation time.

rejected.why: Provisional diagnosis not supported by negative antiplatelet antibodies and abnormal aggregation time; IVIG did not clearly improve platelet count.
